native_source_and_energy_replays.timing_scope: Per-process elapsed and CPU totals include dense operator assembly and solves. The failed original energy attempt had no saved elapsed time.

native_new_comparison.source: 128-bit Arb finite stored operator, Apple arm64, 3 Arb / 2 BLAS threads

first_attempt.failure: Unfactored common normalization gave unresolved direct receiver inertia; original residual norm formula could straddle zero.

native_new_comparison.criterion: Identical per-arm source count, exact total fluence and conservative old noise upper bound under one fixed narrow box.

reported_costs.cost_scope: Time measured per stage. Shared solves reuse inputs. No fictional aggregate CPU cost for unlogged tool attempts, data synthesis, or unmetered model reviews. Individual original receipts include elapsed and CPU when measured.
